en: A monochrome postcard reproducing an old engraved city view: a fortified town with walls and gates spreads across the foreground, while a steep hill rises behind it, crowned by a large fortress complex with multiple towers, churches and defensive walls. Smaller houses, fields and trees occupy the front, and low mountains or hills appear in the distance. The overall style resembles an early‑modern (16th–18th century) Central European city panorama.
